title: Waveshare ESP32-C6-LCD-1.47
hardwareRevision: retained schematic/CAD revision; sale revision unspecified

components: Source BGR color order, mirrorX and RAMCTRL00E8
No touch, IMU or invented I2C devices

facts.label: 来源冲突和采用依据
value: Canonical LCD147 board now uses phase-checked physical GPIO routing, source4MiB capacity and exact shared SPI TF pins; legacy bring-up helper is preserved without routing public products to it.
Official Test.bin is the complete4MiB example image. No retained prose explicitly establishes shipping-recovery purpose; source/example role is retained.
With64MiB FAT32 card, original image reports successful SD initialization and4 read blocks, then originalBLE encryption assertion before anyRAMWR. A black final frame is retained, not substituted.
All184 native components and17.39×32.35-mm active face are preserved. M headers use source9-pin/pitch geometry plus explicit unmeasured body/pin estimates.

limitations: Every native source component is preserved at original millimetre scale. Native material colors are not calibrated hardware color measurements.
No physical fit, enclosure clearance, optical calibration, touch registration or browser WebGL acceptance is claimed.
Known workbench GPIO controls are independent of unverified physical actuator registration; no guessed3D click targets.

value.sourceScope: Exact retained source trees/resources; source target is not firmware acceptance.
